sub_graphs.title: Prague LOG Opcodes: State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions when LOG0-LOG4 opcodes are executed, including stack manipulation and log entry creation

nodes.label: LOG Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: The EVM has fetched a LOG0-LOG4 opcode and is ready to execute it

nodes.label: Pop Stack Values for LOG
nodes.description: Pop memory_start_index, size, and num_topics topic values from the EVM stack

nodes.label: Stack Values Retrieved
nodes.description: Memory start index, size, and topic values have been popped from stack

nodes.label: Calculate LOG Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate total gas: GAS_LOG + (GAS_LOG_DATA * size) + (GAS_LOG_TOPIC * num_topics) + memory expansion cost

nodes.label: Gas Cost Calculated
nodes.description: Total gas cost for LOG operation has been computed

nodes.label: Charge Gas for LOG
nodes.description: Deduct the calculated gas from available gas

nodes.label: Expand Memory if Needed
nodes.description: Expand EVM memory to accommodate the log data region if necessary

nodes.label: Memory Expanded
nodes.description: EVM memory has been expanded to include the log data region

nodes.label: Create Log Entry
nodes.description: Create a log entry with the current contract address, topics, and memory data

nodes.label: Log Entry Created
nodes.description: A new log entry has been created with address, topics, and data

nodes.label: Append Log to EVM Logs
nodes.description: Append the created log entry to the EVM's logs collection

nodes.label: Log Appended to EVM
nodes.description: The log entry is now part of the EVM's logs for this execution context

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Increment the program counter by 1 to move to the next instruction

nodes.label: LOG Execution Complete
nodes.description: LOG instruction has completed successfully, PC advanced to next instruction

sub_graphs.title: Prague LOG Opcodes: Static Context Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation check that prevents LOG operations in static call contexts

nodes.label: LOG Ready for Validation
nodes.description: LOG opcode is about to execute, static context check pending

nodes.label: Check Static Context Flag
nodes.description: Verify that the current execution context is not a static call (STATICCALL)

nodes.label: In Static Context
nodes.description: Execution is within a STATICCALL, which prohibits state modifications including logs

nodes.label: Not in Static Context
nodes.description: Execution is in a normal context where LOG operations are permitted

nodes.label: Raise WriteInStaticContext
nodes.description: Raise WriteInStaticContext exception to abort LOG execution

nodes.label: LOG Execution Aborted
nodes.description: LOG operation has been aborted due to static context violation

nodes.label: LOG Validation Passed
nodes.description: Static context check passed, LOG can proceed

sub_graphs.title: Prague LOG Opcodes: Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for LOG0-LOG4 opcodes including base cost, data cost, topic cost, and memory expansion

nodes.label: LOG Gas Input Values Ready
nodes.description: Size, num_topics, and memory boundaries are known for gas calculation

nodes.label: Apply Base LOG Gas
nodes.description: Start with GAS_LOG base cost constant

nodes.label: Calculate Data Gas
nodes.description: Compute GAS_LOG_DATA * size (proportional to bytes logged)

nodes.label: Calculate Topic Gas
nodes.description: Compute GAS_LOG_TOPIC * num_topics (proportional to topic count)

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Cost
nodes.description: Compute additional gas for memory expansion if needed

nodes.label: Sum Total Gas Cost
nodes.description: Add base + data + topic + memory expansion costs

nodes.label: Total LOG Gas Computed
nodes.description: Final gas cost for LOG operation is determined

nodes.label: Verify Sufficient Gas
nodes.description: Check that available gas is at least equal to computed cost

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for LOG operation

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: Enough gas available to execute LOG

ambiguities.text: The specific values for GAS_LOG, GAS_LOG_DATA, and GAS_LOG_TOPIC constants are not specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these follow the standard EIP-150 gas schedule values (GAS_LOG=375, GAS_LOG_DATA=8, GAS_LOG_TOPIC=375). Should be verified against the gas.py specification.

ambiguities.text: The order of operations between gas charging and static context checking is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume gas is charged first, then static context is checked. This means gas is consumed even if the operation fails due to static context.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion is always safe and bounded by gas costs rather than physical memory limits
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could allow memory exhaustion attacks if gas does not properly account for memory costs

implicit_assumptions.description: Topic values popped from stack are always valid 32-byte values
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malformed topic values could cause issues in log indexing or filtering

implicit_assumptions.description: The contract address used in log entries is the correct current execution context address
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Log spoofing could occur if address is manipulated
